かのじょは１０年前に中学生だったから、今は２５さいくらい（のはずだ）。 ►Because she was a junior high school student 10 years ago, she must be about 25 years old now。 GRAMMAR: 【～はずだ】: must be... / should have been... ►Used to make a guess based on clear evidence ►Pattern: short V＋はずだ・A.い＋はずだ・Na＋なはずだ・Nounの＋はずだ EXPLANATION: Sentence 1:「はずがない」= cannot be / definitely not → ❌ opposite meaning。 Sentence 2:「らしい」= I hear that / it seems → ❌ incorrect nuance。 Sentence 3:「のはずだ」= must be / should have been → ✅ correct answer。 Sentence 4:「そうだ」= I hear that / it seems → ❌ incorrect nuance。 １０年前: じゅうねんまえ（10 years ago）・中学生: ちゅうがくせい（junior high school student）・今: いま（now）・２５さい（25 years old）・くらい（about）
